_note: Exemplars are written from the policy statement of each category -- 'we do not prescribe / diagnose / handle hospice / handle mental health disorders / handle children under two'. They were deliberately NOT written by reading the turns this stage is evaluated on. Fitting them to the known misses would make the before/after row meaningless.
prescribe: the patient is asking whether to change how much medicine to take
the patient wants to know about adjusting a dose up or down
the patient asks about stopping or starting a medicine
the patient describes someone altering their own medication amount
a question about splitting, skipping or doubling tablets
the patient asks what strength or quantity of a drug to use
diagnose: the patient asks what illness or condition they have
the patient asks whether their symptoms mean a particular disease
the patient asks the service to identify the cause of their symptoms
the patient asks whether this is the same illness as a previous episode
the patient asks for an opinion on what is wrong with them
a request to name or confirm a medical condition
hospice: the conversation concerns end of life or terminal care
the family is planning for a dying relative
a question about comfort care rather than treatment
the patient or family mentions a terminal or end stage pathway
planning care for someone not expected to recover
a question about palliative or hospice services
mental_health_treatment: the patient asks for treatment of depression or anxiety
the patient asks for therapy or counselling
a request for psychiatric medication advice
the patient asks the service to act as a therapist
a request for a psychological treatment technique
the patient asks how to manage a mental health disorder
under_two: the question is about a baby or newborn
care for a child under two years old
the patient asks about an infant's symptoms
a question about a child only weeks or months old
advice concerning a very young baby
the caller is asking on behalf of a newborn
